import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }
    
    static class Dinic {
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> graph;
        int[] level, iter;
        int st, ed;
        
        Dinic(int V, int s, int t) {
            graph = new ArrayList<>(V);
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[V];
            iter = new int[V];
            st = s;
            ed = t;
        }
        
        void setEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), cap));
            graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }
        
        boolean assignLevel() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[st] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(st);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int now = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : graph.get(now)) {
                    if (level[e.to] == -1 && e.cap > 0) {
                        level[e.to] = level[now] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[ed] != -1;
        }
        
        int dfs(int now, int flow) {
            if (now == ed) return flow;
            for (; iter[now] < graph.get(now).size(); iter[now]++) {
                Edge e = graph.get(now).get(iter[now]);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[now] < level[e.to]) {
                    int d = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                    if (d > 0) {
                        e.cap -= d;
                        graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                        return d;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long dinic() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (assignLevel()) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int f = dfs(st, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (f == 0) break;
                    flow += f;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }
    
    static int n, ti;
    static int[][] ck = new int[15][15];
    static String[] str = new String[15], es = new String[15];
    static int yy, xx;
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static void go() {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{yy, xx});
        ck[yy][xx] = 1;
        int lev = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q.size();
            for (int it = 0; it < sz; it++) {
                int[] now = q.poll();
                int y = now[0], x = now[1];
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    int ny = y + dy[i], nx = x + dx[i];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (ck[ny][nx] != 0 || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y') continue;
                    ck[ny][nx] = lev;
                    q.add(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
            lev++;
            if (lev > ti) lev = ti;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        ti = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            str[i] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (str[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    yy = i; xx = j;
                }
            }
        }
        // skip blank line (after first grid)
        sc.nextLine();
        // read second grid
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            es[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        go();
        int nodecnt = 0;
        int[][][] table = new int[15][15][65];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = str[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    if (ck[i][j] == 0) ck[i][j] = ti;
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        table[i][j][t] = ++nodecnt;
                    }
                }
                char e = es[i].charAt(j);
                if (e >= '1' && e <= '9') {
                    table[i][j][ck[i][j]] = ++nodecnt;
                }
            }
        }
        int INF = 1000000000;
        int st = 0, ed = nodecnt + 3;
        Dinic net = new Dinic(nodecnt + 5, st, ed);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = str[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    net.setEdge(st, table[i][j][0], c - '0');
                }
                for (int it = 0; it < 4; it++) {
                    int ny = i + dy[it], nx = j + dx[it];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y' || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int t = 0; ; t++) {
                        if (table[i][j][t] == 0) break;
                        if (t == ck[i][j] && es[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') break;
                        if (table[ny][nx][t + 1] != 0) {
                            net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[ny][nx][t + 1], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                char e = es[i].charAt(j);
                if (e >= '1' && e <= '9') {
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[i][j][t + 1], INF);
                    }
                    net.setEdge(table[i][j][ck[i][j]], ed, e - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        long ans = net.dinic();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
